patterns.message: Account-closing logic lives in the API. Reach the backend through @lumenwipe/sdk (via the /api proxy routes), never a local closing module.
The web must not import apps/api directly. Use @lumenwipe/sdk.
apps/web must not import apps/playground. It is isolated on purpose - its custodial demo-account code must never reach production.

no-restricted-syntax.message: mock.module replaces a module for the whole `bun test` process and leaks into other test files depending on file order (it turned CI red on 2026-09-02). Patch the real module object with spyOn(...).mockImplementation(...) and undo it with mock.restore() in afterEach, or inject the dependency.
